summary: No reachable vulnerabilities. src/advice/golden.ts is imported only by tests/golden/*.test.ts (no importer under src/ or e2e/), so the new parsers (parsePostflopGoldenSpots, parseGradedExamples, parseObserved) are test/data-only and their inputs are repo-authored JSON; they still validate from unknown field by field (ids length-capped, percentages finite 0-100, integer hand counts, distinct 3-5 card boards, actions checked against legalActions) and echo() truncates reflected text. No file I/O, eval, dynamic import, regex construction from data, shell, network, or HTML sinks added. The full-ring.json change only flips BTN-vs-raise 99/88 from call to raise and rewrites a static justification string; it is advice content bundled with the app, rendered as data, with no security bearing. Randomness remains the existing seeded equity sampler used for deterministic advice, where no fairness or security property depends on it. No new dependencies; no secrets in the diff.
